workflowBuilder.title: Account Approval Workflows
workflowBuilder.subtitle: Build account approval flows by dragging and connecting steps — no coding required.
workflowBuilder.subtitlePartner: Automate recruiting steps — jobs, applications, pipeline, interviews, offers, and candidate notifications — by dragging and connecting steps.
workflowBuilder.activateConfirmBody: Once activated, this workflow will run automatically. An active workflow cannot be edited directly — future edits create a new draft version.
workflowBuilder.readOnlyNotice: This is the active version and cannot be edited directly. Editing creates a new draft version.
workflowBuilder.advisoryNote: This step is advisory: it always pauses for a human to confirm before anything happens. No AI provider or model details are shown to end users.
workflowBuilder.conflictBody: This workflow was updated elsewhere. Reloading the latest data.
workflowBuilder.permissionDeniedBody: Only members granted this permission can view or edit workflows.
workflowBuilder.listEmptyBody: Create your first workflow to automate account approval or recruiting steps.
workflowBuilder.archiveConfirmBody: Archiving is permanent for this version — it cannot be reactivated. Clone it first if you may need to run it again.
workflowBuilder.dryRunSimulatedBadge: Simulated test run — no real notifications, pipeline moves, or records were created
workflowBuilder.dryRunResultBody: This is a simulation against a synthetic sample event with sensitive fields redacted.
workflowBuilder.noDryRunYetBody: Run a test to see how this flow would behave against a sample event, with no real side effects.
workflowBuilder.noTasksBody: Failed steps from real runs will show up here for manual follow-up.
workflowBuilder.tasksUnavailableForNewBody: Recoverable tasks appear once this workflow has been saved and has run at least once.
workflowBuilder.executionHistoryUnavailableBody: Per-run history for real executions is tracked internally but not yet exposed through an API. This view will list real runs (status, actor, reason, and user-safe errors) once that endpoint ships.
workflowBuilder.activationBlockedBody: This workflow performs actions outside your current permissions. Ask an admin to grant these, or remove the steps you don't have access to.
